source.name: ResellTrack · October 2026 Vinted Barometer
source.method: Independent estimates of detected sales by UK-based sellers. Coverage can change between periods. Brand counts cover leading brands in selected categories. Prices are reported in GBP by the publisher.

analysis.title: High volume can still mean thin margins
analysis.body: Women’s hoodies led detected sales in this sample at a £9 median. Sourcing at a low enough all-in cost matters more than the rank. Generic stock at that median leaves little room for a £15 target profit.

analysis.title: Compare men’s outerwear with knitwear
analysis.body: Men’s coats and jackets and men’s jumpers and sweatshirts had similar detected volume. Outerwear’s median was £19.44 versus £11.66, with similar time to sell among detected sales. Check condition, season and postage on the exact item.

analysis.title: Use brand and category together
analysis.body: Men’s Nike trainers averaged £33.07 versus £16.61 for men’s Nike sportswear and accessories in the tracked segments. For Ralph Lauren, the £20.55 tracked brand average is broad. Look for sold evidence on the same quarter-zip style, size and condition before paying a premium.
